dedupe_keys.name: resilience and disaster recovery rdr tool suite

description: The Resilience and Disaster Recovery (RDR) Tool Suite lets transportation agencies estimate the return on investment of resilience projects for specific transport assets across a range of future conditions and hazard scenarios, so that resilience can be weighed in existing project prioritisation. It applies Robust Decision-Making to deeply uncertain futures and builds on travel demand model networks: users define hazards, asset locations and characteristics, mitigation options and scenarios, and the tool computes changes in damage, downtime, trip costs and benefits over the asset life. It was developed at the Volpe Center with FHWA and OST-R funding and beta-tested with Hampton Roads, Houston-Galveston and Hillsborough planning organisations and the Virginia and Florida DOTs. The method is generic and works for any network a user supplies. The suite is Python-based; its exposure analysis tool and some helpers run in Esri ArcGIS Pro. Releases, a quick start guide, a user guide and reference scenarios are published free on GitHub (public version 2024) under a Volpe Center end user licence agreement. Caveats: it needs a network model and hazard inputs from the user, ArcGIS Pro for exposure analysis, and technical familiarity with Python and GIS. It supports resilience investment appraisal and network flow disruption analysis of road and transit networks, and complements the BTS hazard exposure layers.
